# KS-1238 N83-3 PIN THAT POST /api/documents/:id/verify SENDS NO CALLER BEARER TO THE ANCHOR STORE ON THE CONNECTOR BRANCH — Wednesday's task for Ornith, TEST_ONLY, **ONE existing test file, two one-line replaces, no cell added, no product file** (written 2026-09-19, round 14; AUTH surface, test-only)

File: `Blockchain/Dev/services/api-gateway/src/__tests__/ks1238-hand-forwarded-routes-send-no-caller-bearer.test.ts`
Tip: `ba1210afcab7ddf127cccb270b1c341360261cee`

Written from develop `ba1210afcab7ddf127cccb270b1c341360261cee` (read with `git ls-remote origin refs/heads/develop` and `git rev-parse origin/develop` in the Secuura checkout, read-only, at the start of this brief; #1077-#1083 are merged there, #1083 = KS-1238 N76-1; its tree `993718b84` is the gate's all-seven tree). The test file at that tip is 132 lines; its full content is in `files[...]` of your input. The product the cells pin is `Blockchain/Dev/services/api-gateway/src/routes/verification.ts` (`POST /api/documents/:id/verify`, `:488`; the anchor-store lookup at `:521`). This service runs **VITEST**.

## THE MODE — read this twice

**TEST_ONLY.** Your diff touches EXACTLY ONE file: the test file above, MODIFIED IN PLACE (`--- a/<path>` / `+++ b/<path>`, the path exactly as written above). You never touch `verification.ts`, `index.ts`, `auth.ts` or any other product file: the behaviour is already right at the tip, and this change PINS it.

## What the change pins (one paragraph)

`POST /api/documents/:id/verify` copies `req.headers.authorization` once (`:516`, `authHeader`) and forwards it on up to three upstream calls: originate's `GET /api/documents/:id` (`fetchDocument`, `:517`), anchoring's `GET /api/anchors/document/:id` (`fetchDocFromAnchorStore`, `:521`) and originate's `GET /api/documents/:id` again (`checkDocumentExists`, `:526`). On the connector branch (a valid `x-api-key`, KS-1215) the header is the connector JWT on an OK exchange and absent on a refused one, so today anchoring never sees the caller's own Bearer. #1083 pinned `:516` with the `docslive` / `docsrevoked` cells, but the file's upstream double records only `/api/signatories`, `/api/third-party-verifiers` and `/api/documents/`: the anchor-store call is never recorded. The #1077-#1083 gate (report `2026-09-19-batch1077-1083-tier1-r1`, finding **N83-3**, Minor, KS-1238 item (v)) planted RAW521 (`:521` reads `rawAuthorization` first) and every cell stayed GREEN (0 of 636), while in-process anchoring received the REVOKED session's Bearer. This change makes the double ALSO record `/api/anchors/` hits, so the existing `docslive` / `docsrevoked` cells cover all three /verify upstream calls. No cell is added and no assertion changes: at the tip every /verify call carries the same Bearer, so each cell's distinct set is unchanged.

## The exact change — TWO hunks in the test file

Copy every line byte for byte. Every `+` line is ASCII only. There is no blank line anywhere in the fence. Keep the headers exactly as shown. **Your diff MUST begin with the two file-header lines, above the first `@@` line: `--- a/Blockchain/Dev/services/api-gateway/src/__tests__/ks1238-hand-forwarded-routes-send-no-caller-bearer.test.ts` then `+++ b/Blockchain/Dev/services/api-gateway/src/__tests__/ks1238-hand-forwarded-routes-send-no-caller-bearer.test.ts`.**

1. The upstream double's recording line (`:69`) ALSO records `/api/anchors/` hits (a one-line replace; ONE trailing context line `:70`, which occurs once in the file).
2. The `postVerify` doc comment (`:96`) names both upstreams it now reads (a one-line replace; ONE trailing context line `:97`, which occurs once in the file).

```
@@ -69,2 +69,2 @@
-    if (url.startsWith(SIG) || url.startsWith(TPV) || url.startsWith(DOCS)) hits.push(bearerOf(req.headers.authorization as string | undefined));
+    if (url.startsWith(SIG) || url.startsWith(TPV) || url.startsWith(DOCS) || url.startsWith('/api/anchors/')) hits.push(bearerOf(req.headers.authorization as string | undefined));
     return json(200, { success: true, data: [] });
@@ -96,2 +96,2 @@
-/** POST documents/:id/verify through the real gateway; returns the distinct Authorizations originate received on /api/documents/. */
+/** POST documents/:id/verify through the real gateway; returns the distinct Authorizations originate (/api/documents/) and anchoring (/api/anchors/) received. */
 async function postVerify(headers: Record<string, string>): Promise<string[]> {
```

## Cells

- `docslive` = `RED documents/:id/verify: a valid key + a LIVE user JWT, exchange OK, reaches originate with the connector JWT, not the user Bearer`
- `docsrevoked` = `RED documents/:id/verify: a valid key + a REVOKED session JWT, exchange refused, reaches originate with no Bearer`
- `docsjwtonly` = `control: documents/:id/verify with a LIVE user JWT alone reaches originate with the user own Bearer`

## Tampers

### RAW521 — the /verify anchor-store lookup forwards the pre-auth `rawAuthorization` first (the gate's N83-3)
File: `Blockchain/Dev/services/api-gateway/src/routes/verification.ts`
Line: 521
From:
```
      doc = await fetchDocFromAnchorStore(id, authHeader);
```
To:
```
      doc = await fetchDocFromAnchorStore(id, ((req as any).rawAuthorization || authHeader) as string | undefined);
```
Reds: `docslive`, `docsrevoked`

## Controls

- `docsjwtonly`
- `control: a LIVE user JWT alone reaches originate on both routes with the user own Bearer`
- `control: a valid key alone, exchange OK, reaches originate on both routes with the connector JWT`

## THE CELLS — state it to yourself before you write a line

No cell changes; only what the double records. At the untouched tip the double answers every upstream call `{ success: true, data: [] }` (no `id`), so /verify runs all three lookups and 404s. Key + LIVE JWT: all three calls carry the connector JWT, `['connector-jwt']`. Key + REVOKED JWT, exchange refused: all three carry no Bearer, `['none']`. LIVE JWT alone: all three carry the user's Bearer, `['user:ks1238-live']`. Recording the anchor-store call adds a hit with the SAME value, so each distinct set is unchanged and every cell stays green. Under RAW521 only the anchor-store call changes: key + LIVE gets `['connector-jwt', 'user:ks1238-live']` against `['connector-jwt']`, key + REVOKED gets `['none', 'user:ks1238-revoked']` against `['none']` — both failures by assertion. For the JWT-only control `rawAuthorization` IS the header, so it stays green. The signatories / third-party-verifiers cells never reach `/api/anchors/`, so they stay green.

## Premises (measured)

Measured 2026-09-19 by the round-14 brief subagent at `ba1210afc` (a `git clone --shared` scratch clone, the harness's own `prepare_clone.sh` farm, the service's own `npx vitest run`, JSON report; every plant by line after an exact `From` check, restored by bytes).
- **Premise: the tamper line is unique.** `grep -nFx` of the `From` text over `verification.ts` at the tip: `:521` only (x1), inside `if (!doc) {` under `let lookupSource …` in `router.post('/api/documents/:id/verify'` (`:488`) — the line the gate named. No scope anchor is needed.
- **Premise: the recorder is the gap, not the dedupe.** At the tip the `/api/anchors/` prefix occurs 0 times in the file; the double's `return json(200, …)` answers the anchor-store call, so `:521` runs on every /verify cell (the gate's value table: all three calls carry the same Bearer for every caller).
- **Premise: the `-` lines are unique and no `+` line re-adds a tip line.** `:69` and `:96` occur once each; each `+` line occurs 0 times at the tip. Each hunk's trailing context line (`:70`, `:97`) is non-blank and occurs once. No COMPLETENESS / RAN ledger in the file (grep 0).

## Measured results

- Whole api-gateway suite (vitest 4.1.11) at `ba1210afc`: untouched tip **640/640**; tip + these hunks **640/640**, 0 red (no cell added).
- WITHOUT the hunks: RAW521 **0 red of 640** (the gate's N83-3 gap reproduced; plant sha256 `2c7f6a3dbdef`).
- WITH the hunks: RAW521 **exactly 2 red of 640**, `docslive` (`expected [ 'connector-jwt', 'user:ks1238-live' ] to deeply equal [ 'connector-jwt' ]`) and `docsrevoked` (`expected [ 'none', 'user:ks1238-revoked' ] to deeply equal [ 'none' ]`), both AssertionErrors; `docsjwtonly` and the six signatories / third-party-verifiers cells green. Only this file fails.
- **The real `tasks/test_only/checker.sh` on this brief's own diff** (input `night/inputs/test_only_1238N83-3.json`): **`RESULT: PASS (8/8)`**, strict apply, at `ba1210afc` (T5 9/9 cells; T6 RAW521 exact; T7 the 3 controls green; T8 `verification.ts` restored by bytes, sha256 `43d29242eda1` = tip blob).
- **Product bytes unchanged (TEST-ONLY):** the diff's only file headers are the test file's (checker T2); 2 `+`, 2 `-`. After every leg `verification.ts` sha256 `43d29242eda1` = the tip blob and the clone's `git diff --quiet HEAD` is clean.
- Instrument: whole-service suite with the service's own runner (JSON report), the tamper planted alone by line after an exact `From` check and restored by bytes (sha256 asserted), clone `git status` clean after every leg.

## Output

Exactly ONE ```diff block, nothing outside it: `--- a/Blockchain/Dev/services/api-gateway/src/__tests__/ks1238-hand-forwarded-routes-send-no-caller-bearer.test.ts` / `+++ b/Blockchain/Dev/services/api-gateway/src/__tests__/ks1238-hand-forwarded-routes-send-no-caller-bearer.test.ts`, then the two hunks above exactly as shown, in order.

Refs KS-1238** (item (v), N83-3 Minor, from the batch #1077-#1083 gate `2026-09-19-batch1077-1083-tier1-r1`, NOT-PINNED RAW521). NEVER Closes. KS-1238 stays in Backlog (NOT-COMPLETE): (iii) N83-5, (iv) N83-6, `:598` N83-4 and `:1297` N83-2 remain after this.
- The cell TITLES still say "reaches originate"; they are unchanged on purpose (renaming them is a cell-name change the gate did not ask for). The doc comment on `postVerify` now names both upstreams.
- Same file as the merged #1083 (N76-1); no other queued or held brief touches this file in round 14 (N83-2 / N83-4 are not briefed here).
